text.arabic_uthmani: وَتَحْسَبُهُمْ أَيْقَاظًۭا وَهُمْ رُقُودٌۭ ۚ وَنُقَلِّبُهُمْ ذَاتَ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ ۖ وَكَلْبُهُم بَٰسِطٌۭ ذِرَاعَيْهِ بِٱلْوَصِيدِ ۚ لَوِ ٱطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ لَوَلَّيْتَ مِنْهُمْ فِرَارًۭا وَلَمُلِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ رُعْبًۭا

words.gloss_range: scene-opening conjunction with resumptive and circumstantial force
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as more than a simple additive link. It carries the prior cave scene into a new viewing moment, so the listener is moved from cosmic arrangement to direct perception without losing the boundary with 18:17.

topics.headline: scene-opening bridge into perception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens as a live transition from the cave-and-sun arrangement into direct visual perception.
topics.reason: The opening conjunction rows converge on resumption, circumstance, direct address, and boundary transition from 18:17.

words.gloss_range: second-person estimating verb that assigns the sleepers a false predicate
words.root_gloss_range: reckoning, counting, supposing, and estimating; locally the perceptual-estimation branch is selected while accounting pressure remains audible
words.prose: {{ar:تَحْسَبُهُمْ}} ({{tr:taḥsabuhum}}) puts the addressed observer inside a repeated act of estimation. Its object suffix first places the sleepers under the observer's judgment before the following independent pronoun restates them as the subject of reality. The verb also takes the sleepers as object and assigns the wakeful predicate, so the mistake has grammatical structure: a rational-seeming reckoning reaches the wrong result, a surah-local pressure echoed by other faulty estimations in Surah 18 (18:9, 18:104).

topics.headline: false reckoning as perception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the mistaken sight is framed as an act of reckoning that assigns a predicate, not as a casual glance.
topics.reason: The double-object syntax, 2ms imperfect, object suffix, root range, variant row, and Surah 18 echo rows support false perceptual reckoning, narrowed to the local visual judgment.

words.gloss_range: accusative plural wakefulness assigned by perception rather than reality
words.root_gloss_range: wakefulness, alertness, vigilance, and rousing; locally visible alertness is assigned without an actual awakening process
words.prose: {{ar:أَيْقَاظًا}} ({{tr:ayqāẓan}}) is the visible predicate placed on the sleepers by the estimating verb. Its accusative case keeps wakefulness inside the perception-frame, while the plural adjective makes the whole group look alert; the rare word carries the surface of an illusion rather than an actual awakening.

topics.headline: assigned visible wakefulness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that wakefulness is grammatically marked as the observer's assigned appearance, while the next clause gives the true state.
topics.reason: The accusative second-object parse, wakefulness semantics, broken plural, tanwīn cadence, and hapax rows all preserve the payoff, narrowed away from any real awakening event.

words.gloss_range: circumstantial conjunction introducing simultaneous correction
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) before the reality clause works as a circumstantial and corrective hinge. It does not let the appearance stand alone; it brings the true state alongside the false estimate in the same moment.

topics.headline: simultaneous correction of appearance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the true state is introduced inside the same viewing moment rather than after the mistaken perception has settled.
topics.reason: The circumstantial-conjunction rows and corrective-sequence rows support simultaneity and contrast as the local force.

words.gloss_range: independent plural pronoun stabilizing the sleepers as subject of the real-state clause
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) restates the sleepers independently. After they were held inside the object suffix of the estimating verb, the pronoun makes them the stable collective subject of the reality statement, keeping attention on their state rather than individual identities while still leaving their exact number open (18:22).

topics.headline: stable reality pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same group moves from object of perception to independent subject of reality.
topics.reason: The nominal-clause parse, collective-reference rows, number-contest row, pronoun-chain rows, and synthesis row support a stable subject of reality.

words.gloss_range: nominative plural dormancy as the true settled condition
words.root_gloss_range: sleeping, lying down, sleeping-place, and grave-adjacent stillness; locally living dormancy is selected without collapsing into death
words.prose: {{ar:رُقُودٌ}} ({{tr:ruqūdun}}) closes the opening contrast as the true predicate. Its nominative nominal form makes dormancy settled, while the root family lets the cave sleep press toward sleeping-place and resurrection language without making the sleepers dead (36:52). Because the root also includes lying down on the side, the real sleep is physically ready for the right-left turning that follows.

topics.headline: settled dormancy as truth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sleep receives the final grammatical weight of the opening contrast while also becoming a side-oriented posture prepared for the right-left turning.
topics.reason: The nominative predicate, participial plural, appearance-reality contrast, r-q-d echo with 36:52, and rare-form rows support settled dormancy, narrowed against equating sleep with death.

words.gloss_range: connector pivoting from human estimate to divine action
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pivots the scene from human estimation to divine action. The connector keeps the visual sequence moving while shifting agency from the addressed observer to the first-person divine verb.

topics.headline: perspective pivot to divine action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah turns from what the viewer thinks to what God is doing to preserve the sleepers.
topics.reason: The rows identify coordination, resumption, iltifāt, and a discourse pivot from second-person perception into first-person divine maintenance.

words.gloss_range: first-person Form II turning that makes preservation an ongoing managed bodily rotation
words.root_gloss_range: turning, reversing, changing, outcome, and heart-fluctuation; locally concrete bodily rotation is selected by the right-left complements while broader heart/outcome pressures remain secondary
words.prose: {{ar:نُقَلِّبُهُمْ}} ({{tr:nuqallibuhum}}) makes preservation physical and ongoing. The first-person plural names direct divine agency, Form II makes the turning repeated and causative, and the following bilateral directions narrow the broad root to concrete bodily rotation while still letting the root's heart-and-outcome field resonate within Surah 18 (18:28).

topics.headline: managed bodily preservation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sleepers are not inertly left in place; divine agency repeatedly turns their bodies as active preservation.
topics.reason: The person-shift, Form II, object suffix, directional complements, qiraat agency variants, q-l-b root field, Surah 18 recurrence, and boundary rows converge on managed preservation, narrowed to bodily rotation in the local syntax.

words.gloss_range: accusative construct marker of direction toward the right side
words.root_gloss_range: possession, essence, and side-orientation; locally the construct adverbial selects direction rather than abstract essence
words.prose: {{ar:ذَاتَ}} ({{tr:dhāta}}) turns a possessive or essence word into a directional adverbial. In this first occurrence, the construct phrase marks the side toward which the bodies are turned and repeats the coordinate formula from 18:17.

topics.headline: directional construct marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase marks a measured direction, not an abstract essence of rightness.
topics.reason: The accusative adverbial parse, construct relation, repetition rows, and boundary echo with 18:17 support the directional sense, narrowed away from abstract essence.

words.gloss_range: definite governed right side in the bilateral turning frame
words.root_gloss_range: right side, right hand, oath, blessing, and auspiciousness; locally spatial right side is selected while favorable corpus pressure remains secondary
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْيَمِينِ}} ({{tr:al-yamīni}}) is the definite right side governed by the construct marker. It remains spatial, yet its favorable root associations sharpen the first half of a right-left pair whose totality matters more locally than one-sided blessing.

topics.headline: right side in bilateral care
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the right side is a governed coordinate inside a total right-left preservation pattern.
topics.reason: The genitive governance, definiteness, y-m-n semantic field, y-m-n/sh-m-l pairing, eschatological-pressure rows, and 18:17 echo support a spatial reading with narrowed favorable resonance.

words.gloss_range: conjunction joining the two directional adverbials under one turning verb
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the hinge between the two matched directional phrases. It keeps both sides under the same turning verb and makes the movement one bilateral alternation rather than two unrelated postures.

topics.headline: bilateral hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second direction is coordinated under the same divine turning action, completing the bilateral pattern.
topics.reason: The rows place the conjunction inside the adverbial scope of the same verb and identify its role in completing the merism and cadence.

words.gloss_range: repeated accusative construct marker giving the left side its own directional unit
words.root_gloss_range: possession, essence, and side-orientation; locally the repeated construct marks direction and formal symmetry
words.prose: {{ar:ذَاتَ}} ({{tr:dhāta}}) is repeated rather than left to ellipsis. That repetition gives the second side its own complete directional station, mirroring the bodily alternation and carrying the 18:17 coordinate system into the sleepers' preservation.

topics.headline: repeated directional construct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the left side receives a full repeated marker, making the bilateral care deliberate and measured.
topics.reason: The repeated accusative construct rows, anti-ellipsis rows, local echo rows, and boundary transfer from 18:17 support formal symmetry, narrowed to direction.

words.gloss_range: definite governed left side completing the bilateral coordinate pair
words.root_gloss_range: left side, inclusion, encompassing, and totality; locally spatial left side is selected while encompassing pressure supports the coverage image
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلشِّمَالِ}} ({{tr:al-shimāli}}) completes the governed right-left pair. It remains a spatial left side, but the root's encompassing field helps the phrase read as total coverage: the bodies are turned through both endpoints of the protective axis first named in 18:17.

topics.headline: left side completes coverage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that preservation includes the less-favored side too, so the right-left pair becomes total bodily coverage.
topics.reason: The genitive governance, sh-m-l semantic field, y-m-n/sh-m-l co-occurrence, merism rows, 18:17 echo, and boundary rows support left-side completion with narrowed encompassing pressure.

words.gloss_range: circumstantial connector introducing the simultaneous dog tableau
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) introduces the dog scene as a simultaneous tableau. The connector adds a new visual detail and changes the mode from moving preservation to a static nominal image at the edge of the cave.

topics.headline: motion-to-tableau connector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the scene shifts from ongoing divine motion to a still threshold image without leaving the same moment.
topics.reason: The rows support a circumstantial/additive connector, a third scene-setting beat, and a cinematic shift from verbal motion into nominal stillness.

words.gloss_range: possessed dog as foregrounded guardian participant at the threshold
words.root_gloss_range: dog, fierceness, rabid force, and clasp/fastener imagery; locally the literal dog is selected while guardian and fastening pressures explain its scene role
words.prose: {{ar:كَلْبُهُم}} ({{tr:kalbuhum}}) brings the dog into the scene as their possessed subject, not as an anonymous animal. Its relation to the sleepers makes the same creature companion for them and deterrent for the hypothetical viewer. The standard wording keeps a literal dog, while the guardian-variant and the root's fierceness and clasp pressures explain why this companion functions as a living threshold fastener; its later mention in the number debate confirms its narrative visibility (18:22).

topics.headline: possessed threshold guardian
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the dog is not incidental scenery; possession, subject position, and threshold placement make it a guardian participant.
topics.reason: The nominative possessed subject, relational-protection rows, dog/ferocity/clasp semantics, guardian qiraat rows, Quranic dog-context rows, tableau rows, 18:22 echo, and sound row support a literal dog with narrowed guardian force.

words.gloss_range: active participle of extension, stable in posture yet verbal enough to govern the forelegs
words.root_gloss_range: spreading, extending, opening, expanding, generous reach, and forceful extension; locally bodily extension is selected with guardian valence
words.prose: {{ar:بَاسِطٌ}} ({{tr:bāsiṭun}}) makes the dog's posture both still and active. As a participial predicate it freezes the image, but it also governs the forelegs as the object of extension, turning spread-out reach into the visible form of guarding.

topics.headline: stretched guardian posture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the dog's extension is a stable visual state and an active barrier at the entrance.
topics.reason: The active-participle predicate, verbal governance, extension semantics, dual-valence rows, rare-form rows, recurrence rows, and sound row support stable bodily extension, narrowed to threshold guarding.

words.gloss_range: dual forelegs as the concrete object and measured extent of the dog's extension
words.root_gloss_range: forearm/foreleg, measure, means, capacity, and constricted scope; locally the concrete dual limbs are selected while measure/means imagery supports threshold occupation
words.prose: {{ar:ذِرَاعَيْهِ}} ({{tr:dhirāʿayhi}}) specifies exactly what is extended: the dog's two forelegs. The dual form makes the guardian's body visibly bilateral, echoing the right-left turning pattern and making the threshold feel measured by the animal's reach.

topics.headline: paired forelegs measure the threshold
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices anatomical specificity: two forelegs visibly occupy the threshold and mirror the ayah's bilateral axis.
topics.reason: The dual object, possessive suffix, foreleg/measure/capacity semantics, rare concrete form, bilateral echo, and pacing rows support the concrete limb image, narrowed against abstract means as the local sense.

words.gloss_range: locative preposition anchoring the extension at the threshold
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches the extended posture to the threshold. Its local force is locative, placing the dog at the boundary between cave interior and outside world, while the guarding scene lets location and means converge: the dog guards by being fixed at that boundary point.

topics.headline: locative threshold anchor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the dog's extension is fixed at the boundary, not merely somewhere near the cave.
topics.reason: The locative attachment, instrumental-accompaniment pressure, proclitic fusion, tableau landing, and recitational bond rows support a located posture at the entrance.

words.gloss_range: definite threshold where access and guarded closure meet
words.root_gloss_range: threshold, entrance, shutting, and sealing; locally the entrance noun is selected while sealing pressure makes the doorway a guarded boundary
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْوَصِيدِ}} ({{tr:al-waṣīdi}}) lands the dog tableau on a definite threshold. The word names an entrance, yet its root family carries sealing pressure, so the doorway is not open access but a guarded closure; other sealed-closure contexts invert here into protection rather than punishment (90:20; 104:8).

topics.headline: guarded threshold closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cave entrance is both the access point and the line that is effectively sealed by the guardian scene.
topics.reason: The definite governed noun, threshold/sealing semantics, Form IV derivative rows, protective inversion rows, tableau closure, sound row, and hapax rows support a threshold noun narrowed by sealing pressure.

words.gloss_range: counterfactual particle opening an unreal access frame with certain consequences
words.prose: {{ar:لَوِ}} ({{tr:lawi}}) shifts the ayah from description to counterfactual access. It is not an open if-condition; it imagines a look that did not happen, while the later emphatic answer particles make the imagined consequences certain within that barred scenario.

topics.headline: barred counterfactual access
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that direct looking is grammatically imagined but blocked; the consequences are certain only inside an unreal frame.
topics.reason: The law-plus-perfect construction, contrast with open condition, wish-shadow, qiraat boundary, final-beat rows, and liaison row support counterfactual access, narrowed away from an available next step.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII self-directed peering into protected space under a counterfactual condition
words.root_gloss_range: rising, appearing, coming upon, discovering, scouting, and peering; locally Form VIII selects deliberate visual intrusion while sunrise/exposure pressure remains as echo
words.prose: {{ar:ٱطَّلَعْتَ}} ({{tr:iṭṭalaʿta}}) makes the imagined look active and intrusive. Form VIII presents self-directed peering, and the counterfactual frame keeps that access unreal; the same root that described permitted solar rising across the cave boundary becomes a barred human gaze (18:17; 18:90).

topics.headline: self-directed forbidden peering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the hypothetical look is not neutral seeing but an intrusive attempt to come upon a protected scene.
topics.reason: The perfect after law, Form VIII morphology, scout/rising/peering semantics, Form IV variant contrast, same-surah root echoes, consequence-trigger rows, sound row, boundary rows, and synthesis row support intrusive peering, narrowed to counterfactual visual access.

words.gloss_range: prepositional phrase making the sleepers the object of visual discovery
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِمْ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}) completes the peering construction by making the sleepers the object of discovery. The phrase can imply looking upon or down upon them, but the next consequences reverse that posture: the one who seems above is driven away and overwhelmed.

topics.headline: object of forbidden gaze
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sleepers are grammatically placed under the viewer's gaze, only for that apparent dominance to reverse immediately.
topics.reason: The attachment to the peering verb, object-of-discovery rows, dominance-inversion rows, and pronoun-chain row support the sleepers as target of the forbidden gaze.

words.gloss_range: first response lām certifying the counterfactual result
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) turns the counterfactual condition into its first emphatic result. The look is unreal, but the particle certifies the consequence: retreat would follow without hesitation.

topics.headline: certain first apodosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the imagined flight is not merely possible; it is asserted as certain within the unreal condition.
topics.reason: The lām al-jawāb rows, certainty-inside-irrealis rows, pivot rows, double-apodosis rows, and local echo rows support emphatic first-result force.

words.gloss_range: Form II turning away completed as flight rather than mere reorientation
words.root_gloss_range: nearness, guardianship, alliance, taking charge, turning, and turning away; locally decisive retreat is selected while guardian-nearness reversal remains important
words.prose: {{ar:وَلَّيْتَ}} ({{tr:wallayta}}) makes the first consequence a completed turning away. Form II hardens the retreat, and the following flight noun identifies the turn as fleeing; against the guardian language of 18:17, the same root family now shows the intruder becoming an anti-guardian who cannot stay.

topics.headline: anti-guardian flight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a root of nearness and guardianship is reversed into the observer's decisive inability to remain.
topics.reason: The apodosis tense, complement with the flight noun, w-l-y semantic poles, Form II intensity, battle-retreat field, Surah 18 guardian echo, sound row, boundary rows, and synthesis row support decisive flight, narrowed away from protective nearness.

words.gloss_range: from-them phrase marking the sleepers as source and separation point of flight
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) makes the sleepers the source and separation point of flight. The viewer would flee away from them and because of them, and the fused preposition-pronoun prepares the repeated source phrase in the final terror clause.

topics.headline: source of flight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sleepers themselves become the point from which the observer flees, even though they remain inactive.
topics.reason: The ablative/causal rows, fused-form row, repeated-source frame, parallel rows, and boundary pronoun row support source and separation in the first consequence.

words.gloss_range: indefinite flight noun specifying the turn as instinctive fleeing
words.root_gloss_range: fleeing, escape, and urgent flight; locally panic-response flight is selected rather than orderly withdrawal
words.prose: {{ar:فِرَارًا}} ({{tr:firāran}}) names the body's outward response. Whether read as a cognate-like accusative or as a state, it makes the turning itself flight, not a turn followed by a separate escape; its indefinite form leaves the fleeing unbounded and instinctive, with broader escape language resonating at ultimate-threat scenes (75:10; 51:50).

topics.headline: instinctive flight response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the turn is not followed by escape; the turn itself is characterized as fleeing.
topics.reason: The cognate-accusative/ḥāl parse, f-r-r semantic contrast with controlled withdrawal, indefinite masdar, inter-ayah escape echoes, clause-closure row, and boundary row support instinctive flight, narrowed to the local counterfactual response.

words.gloss_range: conjunction coordinating the second equal result under the same counterfactual
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the second result under the same counterfactual. It links outward flight with inward filling as co-results, preventing the reader from treating terror as merely the later effect of running.

topics.headline: equal second result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that terror does not merely follow flight; both are coordinated consequences of the same impossible look.
topics.reason: The coordination rows, additive-not-sequential rows, external/internal consequence rows, parallel-result rows, and wa-la cadence row support equal co-result force.

words.gloss_range: second response lām giving the terror clause independent emphatic force
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) repeats the answer-particle before the terror clause. The repeated pattern gives inward filling its own emphatic certainty, so the second consequence is not subordinate to the first.

topics.headline: independent terror emphasis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the terror-filling result receives its own certainty, not borrowed emphasis from the flight clause.
topics.reason: The second lām rows, double-certainty rows, la...wa-la pattern, escalation rows, and local refrain row support independent emphatic force.

words.gloss_range: passive perfect filling imposed on the viewer as completed saturation
words.root_gloss_range: filling, fullness, capacity, and gathered fullness; locally passive filling is selected, while assembly/capacity associations remain secondary
words.prose: {{ar:مُلِئْتَ}} ({{tr:muliʾta}}) shifts the counterfactual result inward. The passive perfect makes the viewer a filled patient, with the agent withheld and dread treated as the substance that occupies the person; intensive and hamza-yāʾ variants heighten or smooth the same filling mechanism without changing it.

topics.headline: imposed inner saturation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that terror is not self-generated; the viewer is made the filled patient of an imposed saturation.
topics.reason: The passive construction, source-plus-specification rows, m-l-ʾ filling semantics, assembly branch row, perfect passive form, intensifying variants, rare passive distribution, second-apodosis shift, and phonetic variant row support imposed saturation, narrowed to passive terror filling.

words.gloss_range: from-them phrase marking the sleepers as source of inward terror filling
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) repeats the source phrase with a shifted role. In the flight clause it marked separation from them; here it marks the source from which dread fills the viewer, making the same inactive sleepers both the point fled from and the origin of inward terror.

topics.headline: source of terror filling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated form changes role: the sleepers are now source of inward dread, not just the point fled from.
topics.reason: The causal/source rows, contrast with the first source phrase, repeated fused form, minhum-firāran/minhum-ruʿban pattern, parallel rows, and boundary pronoun row support repeated source with shifted function.

words.gloss_range: accusative terror noun specifying the content that fills and closing the ayah
words.root_gloss_range: terror, dread, and fear as a noun/gerund field; locally terror is the filling substance, with rare root concentration and q-l-b co-occurrence intensifying the closure
words.prose: {{ar:رُعْبًا}} ({{tr:ruʿban}}) supplies the substance of the passive filling and the final landing of the ayah. It can specify the measure or act as retained content, but either way dread becomes something with volume; its rare noun-constrained root and co-occurrence with the turning field tie the final terror back to the bodies being turned earlier in the ayah.

topics.headline: final saturating dread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah closes not on escape but on dread as the substance that would occupy the viewer from within.
topics.reason: The tamyīz/retained-object parse, substance-of-filling rows, variant row, q-l-b co-occurrence rows, final-position row, tanwīn pairing, rare gerund-only rows, and synthesis row support final saturating dread, narrowed to the local passive-filling construction.

baseline_models.mechanism: An observer classifies visible bodies as awake, but the coordinated clause immediately overrides that classification as sleep; posture is insufficient evidence of inner state.

activation_trace.role: Supposition makes the observer's state-classification provisional.
Literal wakefulness supplies the appearance assigned by the observer.
Sleep and stillness supply the concealed state that corrects the appearance.

changed_reading.before: They look awake although they are asleep.
changed_reading.after: The opening is a miniature failed inference: a confident visual classification coexists with its explicit correction.

baseline_models.mechanism: Directed alternation from side to side turns prolonged repose into an externally maintained equilibrium; stillness is preserved through repeated movement.

activation_trace.role: Turning a thing from face to face supplies the repeated maintenance operation.
The right side supplies one pole of controlled alternation.
The left side supplies the opposed pole that completes the alternation.

changed_reading.before: The sleepers are periodically rolled onto either side.
changed_reading.after: Their repose is a managed steady state: preservation is enacted through calibrated reversal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَكَلْبُهُم بَاسِطٌ ذِرَاعَيْهِ بِٱلْوَصِيدِ ... لَوَلَّيْتَ مِنْهُمْ فِرَارًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The dog and its extended forelegs occupy the entrance-space; an attempted look across that boundary produces immediate reversal and fear. Posture, threshold, and affect regulate access.

activation_trace.role: The literal dog supplies the animate figure stationed at the boundary.
Spreading and extension turn the dog's body into a horizontal occupation of space.
The courtyard or threshold supplies the dog's liminal station.
The connected door-space sharpens the boundary as an access point.
Looking in and uncovering the matter supplies the attempted boundary crossing.
Turning away supplies the barrier's immediate behavioral effect.
Fear supplies the affective force that expels the viewer.

changed_reading.before: A dog lies at the entrance, and the sleepers look frightening.
changed_reading.after: The verse composes an access-control scene: a body spans the threshold and the would-be viewer is forced back before inspection becomes entry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context moves from supposition about the cave, through exhaustive reckoning and the sleepers' failed duration estimate, to conjecture about the unseen and finally true sight. The focus becomes the sensory demonstration of epistemic asymmetry.

activation_trace.role: The focus observer's supposition supplies the local misclassification.
The earlier supposition frames the episode as a problem of what one estimates to be extraordinary.
Exhaustive numerical reckoning intensifies the question from impression to exact knowledge.
Repeated duration language exposes the sleepers' own short estimate as inadequate.
Guessing at the unseen names the overreach that the focus observer performs visually.
True seeing closes the sequence by contrasting with the observer's misleading sight.

structural_cues: In 18:18 the corrective وَهُمْ رُقُودٌ follows the observer's supposition without resolving it through closer inspection.
The one-day estimate in 18:19 precedes the explicit three-hundred-plus-nine duration in 18:25.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies supposition, reckoning, failed duration estimates, unseen conjecture, and seeing; I infer that their sequence makes 18:18 an epistemic calibration scene. A live alternative is that the repetitions only coordinate chronology.

changed_reading.before: The observer happens to mistake sleeping bodies for waking ones.
changed_reading.after: The mistake is an embodied epistemic test: sight, self-report, and numerical conjecture fail to master a state whose measure remains hidden.

context_deltas.mechanism: Auditory closure, awakening from stillness, solar deflection, solar passage to the side, and the cave's open interval turn bodily rotation into one operation within a coordinated preservation system.

activation_trace.role: Repeated face-to-face turning supplies bodily maintenance.
Withholding and checking supply the functional image for suspended auditory input.
Rousing a still thing supplies the controlled terminal reversal of sleep.
The sun's veering supplies regulated avoidance at one edge of the daily cycle.
Passing the place to one side supplies complementary solar movement.
The widened interval supplies spatial clearance inside the enclosure.
The later rousing closes the preservation interval and returns the bodies to agency.

structural_cues: The sequence encloses 18:18 between auditory suspension in 18:11, solar routing in 18:17, and awakening in 18:19.
The repeated right/left construction in 18:17 and 18:18 coordinates environmental and bodily orientation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies auditory checking, solar movement, open space, bodily turning, and rousing; I infer a coordinated input-and-position management system. A live alternative is that each protection operates independently.

changed_reading.before: Turning prevents harm during a long sleep.
changed_reading.after: Turning is one actuator in a larger preservation regime regulating sound, light, space, posture, and return to agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: Withdrawal and refuge establish a hidden zone; the focus repels an attempted look at its threshold; later discovery is allowed. The boundary protects not permanent secrecy but the timing of disclosure.

activation_trace.role: The connected door-space supplies the line between hidden interior and approaching viewer.
Inspection supplies the premature disclosure attempt.
Withdrawal supplies the threshold's repelling effect.
Deliberate separation supplies the social boundary that the cave spatializes.
Refuge gives the separated group a protected interior.
Discovery names the feared premature breach of concealment.
Finding what was hidden supplies the later authorized disclosure.

structural_cues: The counterfactual لو اطلعت ... لوليت binds attempted inspection directly to expulsion.
The feared discovery of 18:20 is followed by causative disclosure in 18:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withdrawal, refuge, repelled inspection, feared discovery, and actual discovery; I infer that the boundary controls disclosure timing. A live alternative is that the terror is independent of later publicity.

changed_reading.before: The entrance simply keeps outsiders away.
changed_reading.after: The entrance enforces a temporary disclosure embargo: access is repelled during preservation, then the hidden group is deliberately made known.

context_deltas.mechanism: The youths' hearts are bound firm, and they fear hostile discovery and stoning. In the focus scene force reverses: the outsider turns and is filled with fear while the sleepers remain undisturbed.

activation_trace.role: The viewer's retreat realizes the reversed direction of social force.
Fear supplies the force transferred onto the approaching observer.
Binding the heart supplies the youths' prior affective firmness.
The literal heart locates that firmness internally and activates the focus root's heart branch.
Stones supply the concrete violence the youths expect from discovery.

structural_cues: The hidden group is threatened by discoverers in 18:20, whereas the approaching second-person observer is expelled in 18:18.
The focus juxtaposes externally turned bodies with an internally overwhelmed viewer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies firm hearts, threatened stoning, viewer retreat, and viewer terror; I infer a deliberate reversal of the threat vector. A live alternative is that these are parallel protections without role reversal.

changed_reading.before: A vulnerable hidden group is made frightening to an intruder.
changed_reading.after: Protection reverses the power relation: the group threatened by discovery remains firm while hostile approach is converted into the outsider's flight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dog is possessed by the companions in the focus and recurs unchanged in every proposed count. Its threshold posture marks a member stationed at the margin, not an unrelated animal outside the group.

activation_trace.role: The literal dog is grammatically theirs while physically stationed at the entrance.
Companionship supplies the social category within which the animal is counted.
The dog remains the invariant added term in all three competing enumerations.
Enumeration makes the dog's repeated inclusion evidence of group composition.

structural_cues: The possessive كَلْبُهُمْ recurs in every numerical proposal in 18:22.
In 18:18 the possessive links the dog to the sleepers while the threshold separates its position from theirs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies companionship, possessive attachment, threshold location, and invariant inclusion in counts; I infer liminal membership. A live alternative is that the dog is counted only as a memorable accessory.

changed_reading.before: The dog is an external guard lying near the group.
changed_reading.after: The dog is a companion-at-the-margin: socially included in the group while its body occupies the group's outer boundary.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activates a tool-sense of كلب rather than the focus word's literal animal sense. It remains anchored by the literal dog, spread posture, and closed-door threshold branch. Render only as a material analogy: the dog functions like a clasp across access, not as a replacement meaning for 'dog.'

activation_trace.role: The hooked implement that holds supplies a latch-like material analogy for the literal dog.
Extending a limb supplies the spanning action of the analogy.
A firmly closed door supplies the access point across which the dog acts latch-like.

changed_reading.before: The dog guards the doorway by presence.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material overlay, the dog and its forelegs form a living clasp across the cave's access point.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The water-filled valley is a distant branch of رعب, while the focus uses fear. It remains anchored by the explicit filling verb governing terror. Render as an image-level overlay: fear inundates a bounded capacity, without claiming that رعب literally means water here.

activation_trace.role: Filling to a container's measure casts the observer as fully occupied.
A torrent filling a valley supplies the inundation image for the fear occupying the observer.

changed_reading.after: As an exploratory material image, terror floods the observer until no capacity for approach remains.

strongest_changes: Apparent wakefulness becomes an embodied test of sight, counting, and conjecture.
Turning becomes one actuator in a coordinated preservation system.
The threshold protects the timing of disclosure rather than permanent secrecy.
The focus reverses the threatened youths' vulnerability onto the approaching observer.
The repeatedly counted dog reads as a group member stationed at its margin.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses epistemic error, bodily maintenance, boundary control, social reversal, and companion membership into one visual tableau without collapsing them into a single interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: System-level coordination is inferred from sequence rather than explicitly stated causation.
The disclosure model may overconnect the hypothetical viewer with later publicity.
The latch and inundation readings are branch-backed analogies and must remain exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Visible posture produces a false reckoning that still protects.** `ح س ب` B002 (“reckoning as supposition”) makes wakefulness an observer’s inference, contradicted by their actual sleep. Later the garden owner and failed workers also “suppose” falsely (18:35–36, 104), but here misperception deters intrusion. I infer that misleading appearance is causally protective without becoming truth. The ayah separates providential use of an appearance from epistemic endorsement of it.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:104 made protective misappearance here contrast with culpable self-misclassification of one’s own work.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Outer reversal preserves an inwardly fastened state.** `ق ل ب/B004` supplies physical or abstract turning and reversal. The bodies alternate right and left after the sun does so in 18:17, whereas their hearts were `رَبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ` in 18:14, activating `ق ل ب/B001` as the inward faculty. I infer that controlled external change prevents destructive change while inward commitment remains stable. `نُقَلِّبُهُمْ` reads as maintenance by alternation, not restless instability.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:19’s awakening confirmed that the repeated bodily reversals preserve rather than destabilize; 18:21 extended preservation into public proof.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Refuge works by regulating passage across a boundary: persons enter, mercy and light reach them selectively, and hostile access is repelled.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The cave is neither sealed nor simply open; it behaves as a selectively permeable shelter.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Threshold Converts Looking into Flight
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The dog occupies the entrance while an approaching observer is allowed only a glimpse before terror reverses the approach.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A period of immobilized awareness becomes knowable only when awakening converts duration into comparison, number, and dispute.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Awakening does not simply restore activity; it produces the epistemic problem by which hidden time can be measured.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hearing Is Withheld While Bodies Remain
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An imposed restraint reaches the ears, consciousness enters sleep, and bodies persist in a state that resembles wakefulness without ordinary reception.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Suspension is organized through the sensory gate most closely tied to receiving a call. The bodies remain visibly present while the channel that would reconnect them to surrounding time is held closed.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The contrast joins visual illusion, economic confidence, false allegiance, and skilled labor under one epistemic failure.

concept_map.definition: Uyuma durumunu bildirir. Zamanı kimi kullanımlarda geceyle sınırlanırken kimi kullanımlarda gece ve gündüzü kapsar; hafif ve hoş uyku da özel bir gerçekleşme olarak yer alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, yaymayı toplamanın açık karşıtı olarak kurar ve işlemin sonuç durumunu da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, araziyi ve genel fiziksel genişliği daha açık biçimde kendi kapsamına alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyin fiziksel olarak yayılması, uzaması ve daha geniş alan kaplaması bölgesinde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu büyük ölçüde aynı fiziksel hareket alanındadır; ancak arazi ve genişlik kapsamı daha belirgindir. Odak dalın sınırı ise toplamanın karşıtı olan yayma işlemine dayanır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بسط الشيء ونشره وتوسيعه وانبساطه على الأرض وكون الشيء مبسوطا
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو امتداد الشيء في عرض أو غير عرض (maqayis)؛ البسط نقيض القبض (ayn)؛ بسط الشيء نشره وانبسط الشيء على الأرض (sihah)؛ البسط نقيض القبض (tahdhib)؛ بسط الشيء نشره وتوسيعه (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البساط والبسيطة من الأرض، والمكان البسيط أو البساط، والأرض العريضة الواسعة المستوية، وما يبسط من المتاع

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi eli, kolu veya avucu uzatıp serbest bırakmayı; isteme, alma, saldırma ve verme amaçlarıyla sınırlar. Cömertlik bu hareketin bir gerçekleşimidir, dalın tek başına soyut çekirdeği değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım el, kol ve avuçla kurulan kalıplara bağlıdır; buradan yalın kök için bağımsız bir verme veya saldırma anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: El, kol veya avucu bir şeye doğru uzatıp serbestçe kullanmak; bağlama göre isteme, alma, saldırma ya da verme yönelimi taşımaktır.

facets.statement: Elin, kolun veya avucun uzatılıp hareket alanına çıkarılması temel fiziksel işlemdir.
Bu hareket isteme, alma, saldırma veya bolca verme amaçlarından biriyle belirlenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar uzatılmış ve serbest bırakılmış el imgesinde birleşir; isteme, alma, saldırma ve verme bu ortak hareketin bağlamsal yönelimleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: El, kol veya avucun isteme, alma, saldırma ya da verme amacıyla uzatıldığı kalıplarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Fiziksel uzatmayı, serbest kullanımı ve farklı amaçlara açık yönelimi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Elin serbestliği özellikle bolca verme ve harcama yönünde kullanıldığında doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Serbest el imgesini ve verme yönelimini korur.
error_profile.loses: İsteme, alma ve saldırma amaçlı el uzatma kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalda el verme dahil çeşitli amaçlarla uzatılır ve kullanım alanına çıkarılır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalda el özellikle vermekten alıkonur; engelleme, cimrilik ve tutma öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal elin verme alanındaki serbestliği veya tutulması üzerinden ortak bir davranış ekseni kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Verme bağlamında odak elin açılması ve serbest kullanılması yönündedir, komşu ise vermeyi engelleme yönündedir. Odak dalın isteme, alma ve saldırma kapsamı bu karşıtlık eksenini aşar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; elin vermeye açılması ile vermekten tutulması arasındaki karşıtlık en açıklayıcı sınırı verdi, diğer adaylar yalnız el temasını veya tek bir hareketi paylaştı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بسط اليد والذراع والكف للطلب أو الأخذ أو الصولة أو البذل والإعطاء، واليد المطلقة أو المبسوطة
branches.source_phrase_ar: يد فلان بسط إذا كان منفاقا (maqayis)؛ بسط إلينا فلان يده بما نحب ونكره (ayn)؛ يد بسط أي مطلقة وبل يداه بسطان (sihah)؛ بسط فلان يده بما يحب ويكره وبسطان مبسوطتان (tahdhib)؛ بسط اليد مدها وبسط الكف للطلب والأخذ والصولة والبذل (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الرجل المنبسط اللسان، والمرأة البسيطة، والانبساط بمعنى ترك الاحتشام، والوجه البسط المحبوب للناس
يدخل فيه قولهم يبسطني ما بسطك أي يسرني ما سرك ويقابل يقبضني بمعنى يسوءني
يدخل فيه تبسط في البلاد بمعنى سار فيها طولا وعرضا، والتبسط بمعنى الخروج للتنزه في أرض ذات رياحين
يدخل فيه البسط أو البساط من النوق، وهي الناقة التي تركت مع ولدها أو خليت لا يمنع منها ولا تعطف على غير ولدها
يدخل فيه البسيط بوصفه نوعا أو جنسا من العروض
يدخل فيه بسط العذر بمعنى قبوله
يدخل فيه العقبة الباسطة بمعنى البعيدة الطويلة، والقامة الباسطة وهي مدى القامة مع مد اليد
يدخل فيه استعمال البسط في كل شيء لا يتصور فيه تركيب وتأليف ونظم
يدخل فيه الباسوط من الأقتاب ضد المفروق والقتب المبسوط الذي يجمع على مباسيط

root_profile.summary: Kökün merkezinde fiziksel olarak yayma ve uzatma bulunur; buradan serili yüzey, genişlik ve artış, elin uzatılması, sosyal rahatlık, sevindirme, dolaşma ve serbest bırakma gibi bağlantılı anlamlar gelişir. Şiir ölçüsü, gerekçe kabulü, mesafe ölçüsü, yapısal bileşiksizlik ve özel deve semeri adları ise daha uzmanlaşmış dallar oluşturur.

Bir şeyin yere yayılıp uzanmış sonuç durumunu taşımaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, insan kolunu dirsekten orta parmak ucuna kadar uzanan organ olarak tanımlar; hayvanın ayaklarını bunun işlevsel karşılığı sayar ve kolları dışarı çıkarma kullanımını ayrıca verir. Hazırlanan çerçeve bu ana anlamı ve ona bağlı kullanımları doğru biçimde korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak organ anlamını, hayvandaki karşılığını ve yalnızca belirli söz öbeğinde görülen dışarı çıkarma eylemini birbirine karıştırmadan ayırır.

concept_map.definition: İnsanda dirsekten orta parmak ucuna kadar uzanan kol ve el bütününü anlatır. Hayvanın ayaklarına işlevsel olarak genişler; belirli bir kalıpta ise kolları dışarı çıkarmayı bildirir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde dirsekten orta parmak ucuna uzanan kol ve el bütünüdür.
Hayvanın ayakları, insan kolunun işlevsel karşılığı olarak bu adla anılır.
Belirli bir eylem kalıbı, iki kolu dışarı çıkarmayı ifade eder.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Birleşik anlatım insan kolunu açık bir anatomik sınırla verir, hayvan ayaklarını ona benzeterek kapsar ve kolların dışarı çıkarıldığı özel eylemi ayrı bir kullanım olarak kaydeder.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan bedenindeki temel organ anlamını, el bölümünü de dışlamadan karşılayan en kısa doğal anlatımdır.

error_profile.preserves: Organın başlangıç ve bitiş sınırlarını ve kol bütünlüğünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hayvan ayaklarının insan koluna denk uzuvlar olarak adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvandaki uzuv karşılığını açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca iki kolun dışarı çıkarılmasını bildiren özel eylem kalıbında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kalıba bağlı hareketi ve iki kolun dışarı yönelmesini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: dirsekten orta parmak ucuna uzanan kol

error_profile.preserves: Uzvun parmaklara uzanan uç bölümünü çağrıştırır.
error_profile.loses: Dirsekten başlayan kol bölümünü ve organın bütün sınırını dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.collision: Gündelik kullanımda yalnızca bilekten sonraki bölümü düşündürür.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle el organını ve elin yaralanma, kesilme ya da yakalanma durumlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal insanın üst uzvunda, özellikle el bölümünde kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu, kolun uç organı olan eli merkez alır; odak ise dirsekten parmak ucuna kadar bütün uzvu tanımlar ve hayvandaki karşılığını da içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal el bölümünü de içeren daha uzun organ bütününü ve hayvan ayağı genişlemesini taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yardım eden ön kol bölümünü ve kuş kanadındaki işlevsel benzerini merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal üst uzvun dirseğe bağlı bölümünü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu daha dar bir ön kol parçasına odaklanırken odak dal dirsekten orta parmak ucuna kadar uzanan bütünlüğü verir.

branches.what_is_ar: ذرع الثوب والحائط وغيرهما بالذراع والمذروع والمقدار المعدود بالأذرع وما بلغ قدر ذراع

الذرع بمعنى الطاقة والوسع واحتمال الأمر وضيق الذرع والعجز عن بلوغ المراد ومجاوزة القدر

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözcüğü doğrudan avlu anlamındaki başka bir biçimin dilsel çeşidi olarak tanımlar. Hazırlanan dalın avlu odağı bu tek kaynaklı ve açık tanımla tam olarak örtüşür.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın biçimin avlu anlamıyla sınırlıdır ve komşu biçimin kapı gibi ek anlamlarını ya da başka söz öbeklerini içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir evin ya da yapının çevresinde veya önünde bulunan açık alan, yani avludur.

facets.statement: Bir yapıyla bağlantılı açık alanı, başka bir deyişle avluyu belirtir.
Bu anlam, aynı avlu adının dilsel bir biçim değişkesi olarak aktarılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynak, biçimi avlu anlamındaki eşdeğer bir söyleyiş çeşidi olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yapıyla bağlantılı açık alan anlamını tam ve doğal biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yapıya bağlı açık alan anlamını eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Açık alanın bir eve bağlı olduğunun bağlamda belirtilmesi gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Avlunun bir yapıyla bağlantılı açık alan olmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Ev dışındaki yapılara bağlı avlu olasılığını sınırlar.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal evle bağlantılı avlu veya açık alan anlamında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel avlu adıdır; komşu dal alanın evin yanlarına uzanması ve önündeki genişlik gibi mekânsal ayrıntıları ayrıca taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kaynakta başka bir avlu adının söyleyiş çeşidi olarak belirlenmiştir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal evin saha ve açık alanını daha genel bir yer adıyla ifade eder.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir evin avlusunu veya açık sahasını gösterebilir.

root_profile.summary: Kök, kuşatıp kapatma çekirdeğinin yanında içindekileri çevreleyen bir alanı, kız çocuklarına özgü küçük iç gömleğini, avluyu ve dağlar arasındaki çukur yer ile buna bağlı belirli yer kullanımını taşıyan birkaç ayrı sözlüksel dalda örgütlenir.

concept_gloss.text: üzerine kapatma, kapı kapatma ve kapatılmış kullanım

contextual_glosses.text: bir şeyi ya da kimseleri üstten kapatıp kuşatma

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, kapıyı kapatma kullanımının arkasında bir şeyi başka bir şeye katıp bitiştirme çekirdeğini de açıkça verir. Bu nedenle sağlanan kapı çerçevesi geçerlidir, ancak dalın bütününü yalnızca kapıyla sınırlandırmamak gerekir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel bitiştirme çekirdeğini kapıya bağlı eylem ve kapalı durum bildiren biçimlerle kaynaştırmadan ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka bir şeye katıp bitiştirme düşüncesidir. Kapı bağlamında iki yüzeyi birbirine getirerek kapıyı örtmeyi, sıkıca kapatmayı ve böyle kapalı durumda bulunmayı anlatır.

facets.statement: Temel ilişki, bir şeyi başka bir şeye katıp iki şeyi birbirine bitiştirmektir.
Kapıya bağlı gerçekleşimde kapı örtülür, iki yüzey birbirine getirilir ve kapanış sağlamlaştırılır.
Eylemin sonucu, kapının bütünüyle örtülmüş ve sıkıca kapalı durumda bulunmasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, bitiştirme temelini kapının örtülüp kapanmasıyla ilişkilendirir; kapatma eylemi, sıkılık ve ortaya çıkan kapalı durum aynı anlam çevresinde yer alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Genel bitiştirme çekirdeğini ve kapı bağlamındaki örtme, sağlam kapatma ve kapalı sonuç bütününü birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Bitiştirme işlemini, sıkı kapanışı ve bunun sonucundaki kapalı durumu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kapının örtülerek sağlam biçimde kapatıldığı eylem bağlamlarında doğal bir karşılıktır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü bakıp öğrenme, başkasına gösterip bildirme, başı görünür kılma ve birinin görüşünü yoklama işlemlerini aynı dalda verir. Bunlar tek bir katılımcı düzenine indirgenemeyeceği için dal, görünür veya bilinir kılma ortaklığı korunarak ve katılımcı değişimleri açıkça ayrılarak kabul edilebilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeye bakarak onun iç yüzünü öğrenmek veya onu başkasına görünür ya da bilinir kılmaktır; birinin görüşünü araştırma ve başı dışarı çıkarıp gösterme de bu kuruluşlara bağlı özel işlemlerdir.

facets.statement: Gözlemleyen kişi bir şeye yukarıdan bakar ya da iç yüzüne erişerek onu bütünüyle öğrenir.
Bilgiyi bilen kişi, bir işi veya saklı sözü başkasına göstererek onun da bilmesini sağlar.
Bir kişinin başını dışarı çıkarıp görünür kılması, fiziksel gösterme alt kullanımını oluşturur.
Birinin ne düşündüğünü anlamak için görüşünü araştırmak, bilgi edinme işleminin özel bir uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar bir şeyi gözleyip iç yüzünü öğrenme ile bilinen şeyi başkasına gösterip bildirme yönlerini birlikte verir. Başı görünür kılma, bir metni inceleme ve birinin görüşünü yoklama bu ortak görünürlük ve bilgi edinme düzeninin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca kabın dolu olmasını değil, bir şeyi doldurma eylemini, dolu kabın aldığı miktarı ve belirli insan ya da yay kullanımlarını da kapsar. lexicalization_scope.note: Dal hem yalın biçimlerle anlatılan doldurma, doluluk ve kap miktarını hem de insanın dolması ve yayın güçlüce çekilmesi gibi yalnızca belirli kalıplarda bulunan kullanımları ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi alabileceği yere kadar doldurma, dolu duruma gelme ve dolu bir kabın aldığı miktardır. Buna bağlı özel kullanımlar, insanın yemek, içecek ya da öfkeyle dolmasını ve yayı güçlüce çekmeyi anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi içindeki boşluk kalmayacak ya da sınırına ulaşacak biçimde doldurma ve onun dolu duruma gelmesi.

İnsanın yemek, içecek ya da öfkeyle dolmuş sayılması.
Yay çekme kalıbında çekişi güçlendirme ve ileri ölçüde yapma.
